clubs.name: Clubhouse
clubs.note: Clubhouse with swimming pool: his/her change rooms, gym, indoor & outdoor games areas, multi-purpose hall, squash court, table tennis, cardroom and billiards/pool room.

items.label: Flooring
items.value: Marble/vitrified tiles flooring in living, dining & lobby. Wooden/vitrified tile flooring in bedrooms. Vitrified tiles in kitchen. Utility, servant room and toilets in ceramic tiles. Staircase & landings to be provided in marble/kota, terrazzo flooring. Balconies will be in anti-skid ceramic flooring.

items.label: Dado
items.value: Ceramic tiles of required height in Toilets & 600mm height above Kitchen Counter Slab in appropriate Colour & Paint.

items.label: Painting
items.value: OBD of appropriate colour on interior walls & Ceilings.

items.label: Kitchen
items.value: All Kitchen Counters in pre-polished Granite/premium marble Stone, electrical points for Kitchen Chimney & Hob. Stainless Steel Sink, premium CP Fittings.

items.label: Doors & Windows
items.value: Main entrance door as engineered door with Polished Wood Veneer and Solid Wood/Timber Frame. All internal doors are flush/skin doors-polished/enamel painted; stainless steel/brass finished hardware fittings for main door & aluminium powder coated hardware fitting and locks of branded make. Door frames and window panels of aluminium/UPVC sections. All hardware in powder coated aluminium. Size and section as per design of the architect.

items.label: Plumbing
items.value: As per standard practice, all internal plumbing in GI/CPVC/Composite.

items.label: Toilet
items.value: Premium sanitary fixtures. Premium Chrome Plated fittings.

items.label: Electrical
items.value: All electrical wiring in concealed conduits; provision for adequate light & power points. Telephone & T.V. outlets in Drawing, Dining and all bedrooms; moulded modular plastic switches & protective MCB's.

items.label: Exterior
items.value: Appropriate finish of Texture Paint of exterior grade.

items.label: Lift
items.value: Lifts to be provided for access to all floors.

items.label: Generators
items.value: Generator to be provided for 100 % backup of Emergency & Safety facilities, Lifts & Common areas.

items.label: Security & FTTH
items.value: Provision for Optical fiber network; Video surveillance system, Perimeter Security and Entrance lobby Security with CCTV cameras; Fire prevention, suppression, Detection & alarm system as per fire norms.

items.label: Structure
items.value: Earthquake resistant RCC framed structure as per applicable Seismic Zone.
